R261.note: Owner lookup gates deleteById correctly, but returning 403 for an existing non-owned document reveals existence, which the stated contract says must not exceed the existing not-found path.

R262.note: Tika.detect(byte[]) sniffs magic bytes and ignores the client-chosen suffix; storage path and UUID naming untouched, only cost is readAllBytes buffering the upload in memory, which multipart size limits already bound.

R263.note: Positional $1/$2 placeholders with Sequelize bind hand the values to driver-side binding; result shape, type option and error propagation unchanged.

R264.note: RESP multibulk encoding length-prefixes every argument so CRLF/whitespace in session_id or locale cannot split arguments or add a command; same HSET semantics, same response handling.

R265.note: Caps length against receivedByteCount - 2 after the existing < 2 guard, so memmove never reads past received data or the array; fully received messages behave as before.

R266.note: Dropping cmd.exe and passing an argument array to an absolute PING.EXE closes the shell vector and the leading-dash block is needed for CWE-88, but the added host charset/length allowlist and 1-9999 count bound reject inputs the original accepted (e.g. underscores, zone IDs) beyond what the contract calls for, even though stated.

R267.note: Removing the template.HTML cast restores html/template contextual escaping; review text still renders, now as inert text, and the write-up states that.

R268.note: realpath plus commonpath containment closes the traversal, but the added rejection of any '/' or '\\' in the filename is an extra restriction beside a check that already closed the sink and would reject a subdirectory path the original accepted.

R269.note: session_regenerate_id() placed after credential success and before session writes closes fixation; return values and control flow unchanged.

R270.note: Decoding into a jobWire DTO without IsAdmin keeps the gob format (extra stream fields are ignored) and hard-sets IsAdmin false, matching the contract that the server decides privilege.

R271.note: PasswordEncoder.matches gates the token; the new PasswordEncoder constructor dependency and the switch from UsernameNotFoundException to BadCredentialsException are both stated and do not block legitimate logins (ProviderManager already hides the former by default).

R272.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) closes the overflow; the [TRUNCATED] marker, return 1 on truncation and -2 on encoding error are stated plainly and do not stop any caller.

R273.note: GetFullPath plus separator-suffixed StartsWith containment closes the traversal and the File.Exists 404 is stated, but the GetFileName equality check is an extra restriction beside an already-sufficient containment check and rejects subdirectory names the original accepted.
